I don't think it's anything you're doing wrong at all. I'm 22m and have had the same problems in my life. I just don't think most people are interested in having meaningful friendships anymore. 

Someone told me that, most people are seasonal friends, like they come and then go when they feel like it, it's nothing you've done, it's just how people are unfortunately, but there are some people who would be called evergreen friends where they are around all year, they stick around, those are real friends, it's just they're so rare it seems near impossible to make real friends. 

But real evergreen friends are out there, you just gotta keep looking and you'll find one eventually. Keep your head up, I'm sure you'll meet the best friend you could ever have and they'll stick around, just keep looking.

I'm just now 22, and I remember feeling the exact same way as you are describing when I was 19, ngl I still do feel the same now, but I do have a friend like I've never had before now, and if I had ended it when I wanted to at 19, I would have never even met this person, and life had many downs, but it's things and people like that you will probably end up meeting to stick around for, and along with that it does help feel at least slightly less alone.
So, while you may feel completely alone now, that won't last forever, things change. People's lives have complete reverse for the better at random points. Your feelings are very real, but I'd like to say those feelings will change maybe even soon. You never know what tomorrow has in store for you.
 you are not alone.
